### FILE: backend/prisma/schema.prisma
```prisma
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model Incident {
  id           String    @id @default(cuid())
  type         String
  sensor       String
  value        Float
  message      String
  acknowledged Boolean   @default(false)
  resolvedAt   DateTime?
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now())
}

model AlertLog {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  channel   String
  message   String
  success   Boolean
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}

model ComplianceRecord {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  date          DateTime
  zone          String
  safeMinutes   Int      @default(0)
  unsafeMinutes Int      @default(0)

  @@unique([date, zone])
}
```

## STEP 2 â€” DATABASE SETUP

### FILE: backend/src/influx.js
```javascript
const { InfluxDB, Point } = require('@influxdata/influxdb-client');

const client = new InfluxDB({
  url: process.env.INFLUX_URL,
  token: process.env.INFLUX_TOKEN,
});

const writeApi = client.getWriteApi(
  process.env.INFLUX_ORG,
  process.env.INFLUX_BUCKET,
  'ns'
);

const queryApi = client.getQueryApi(process.env.INFLUX_ORG);

async function writeInflux(data) {
  const point = new Point('sensor_readings')
    .floatField('mq2', data.mq2)
    .floatField('temperature', data.temperature)
    .floatField('humidity', data.humidity)
    .intField('flame', data.flame)
    .intField('rain', data.rain)
    .intField('risk_score', data.riskScore)
    .tag('level', data.riskLevel)
    .timestamp(new Date());
  writeApi.writePoint(point);
  await writeApi.flush();
}

async function queryInflux(fluxQuery) {
  const results = [];
  await queryApi.collectRows(fluxQuery, (row, tableMeta) => {
    results.push(tableMeta.toObject(row));
  });
  return results;
}

module.exports = { writeInflux, queryInflux };
```

## STEP 3 â€” MOCK DATA SIMULATOR

### FILE: simulator/sensors.js
```javascript
function rand(min, max) {
  return parseFloat((Math.random() * (max - min) + min).toFixed(1));
}

function generateNormal() {
  return { mq2: rand(50, 180), temperature: rand(22, 35), humidity: rand(45, 70), flame: 0, rain: 0 };
}

function generateWarning() {
  return { mq2: rand(200, 390), temperature: rand(38, 46), humidity: rand(20, 35), flame: 0, rain: 0 };
}

function generateCritical() {
  return {
    mq2: rand(500, 900),
    temperature: rand(55, 75),
    humidity: rand(5, 18),
    flame: Math.random() > 0.4 ? 1 : 0,
    rain: Math.random() > 0.6 ? 1 : 0,
  };
}

let gasLevel = 60;
function generateGradualSpike() {
  gasLevel = Math.min(gasLevel + rand(8, 25), 850);
  return { mq2: parseFloat(gasLevel.toFixed(1)), temperature: rand(28, 42), humidity: rand(30, 55), flame: 0, rain: 0 };
}

function resetGas() { gasLevel = 60; }

module.exports = { generateNormal, generateWarning, generateCritical, generateGradualSpike, resetGas };
```

### FILE: simulator/index.js
```javascript
require('dotenv').config();
const axios = require('axios');
const { generateNormal, generateWarning, generateCritical, generateGradualSpike, resetGas } = require('./sensors');

const BACKEND_URL = process.env.BACKEND_URL || 'http://localhost:4000';
const INTERVAL_MS = parseInt(process.env.INTERVAL_MS) || 2000;

// Auto scenario: loops through realistic hazard progression
const SCENARIO = [
  { mode: 'normal',   duration: 15 },
  { mode: 'spike',    duration: 20 },   // gradual gas rise â†’ tests anomaly detection
  { mode: 'warning',  duration: 10 },
  { mode: 'critical', duration: 8  },
  { mode: 'normal',   duration: 12 },
];

let scenarioIdx = 0;
let scenarioCount = 0;
let mode = SCENARIO[0].mode;

function getReading() {
  switch (mode) {
    case 'warning':  return generateWarning();
    case 'critical': return generateCritical();
    case 'spike':    return generateGradualSpike();
    default:         return generateNormal();
  }
}

async function send(reading) {
  try {
    await axios.post(`${BACKEND_URL}/api/sensors/reading`, reading);
    console.log(`[${mode.toUpperCase()}] MQ2:${reading.mq2}ppm T:${reading.temperature}Â°C H:${reading.humidity}% F:${reading.flame} R:${reading.rain}`);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Send error:', e.message);
  }
}

setInterval(async () => {
  await send(getReading());
  scenarioCount++;
  if (scenarioCount >= SCENARIO[scenarioIdx].duration) {
    scenarioIdx = (scenarioIdx + 1) % SCENARIO.length;
    scenarioCount = 0;
    mode = SCENARIO[scenarioIdx].mode;
    if (mode === 'normal') resetGas();
    console.log(`\n--- SCENARIO â†’ ${mode.toUpperCase()} ---\n`);
  }
}, INTERVAL_MS);

console.log(`Simulator â†’ ${BACKEND_URL} | Interval: ${INTERVAL_MS}ms`);
```

### FILE: backend/src/socket/socketHandler.js
```javascript
function setupSocket(io, prisma) {
  io.on('connection', async (socket) => {
    console.log('Client connected:', socket.id);
    // Replay last 20 incidents so new tab has data immediately
    const incidents = await prisma.incident.findMany({ orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, take: 20 });
    incidents.reverse().forEach(i => socket.emit('alert', i));
    socket.on('disconnect', () => console.log('Client disconnected:', socket.id));
  });
}
module.exports = { setupSocket };
```

### FILE: backend/src/mqtt/mqttClient.js
```javascript
const mqtt   = require('mqtt');
const config = require('../config');
const { calculateRiskScore, getRiskLevel } = require('../services/riskScore');
const { processAlert }  = require('../services/alertEngine');
const { checkAnomaly }  = require('../services/anomalyClient');
const { writeInflux }   = require('../influx');
const { pushThingSpeak } = require('../services/thingspeak');

function setupMQTT(io, prisma) {
  const client = mqtt.connect(config.MQTT_BROKER);
  client.on('connect', () => { console.log('MQTT connected'); client.subscribe(config.MQTT_TOPIC); });
  client.on('message', async (_topic, message) => {
    try {
      const { mq2, temperature, humidity, flame, rain } = JSON.parse(message.toString());
      const riskScore = calculateRiskScore({ mq2, temperature, humidity, flame, rain });
      const { level: riskLevel } = getRiskLevel(riskScore);
      const anomaly = await checkAnomaly({ mq2, temperature, humidity, flame, rain });
      const data = { mq2, temperature, humidity, flame, rain, riskScore, riskLevel, anomaly, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };
      io.emit('sensorUpdate', data);
      await writeInflux(data);
      pushThingSpeak({ mq2, temperature, humidity, flame, rain });
      await processAlert(data, riskScore, anomaly, io, prisma);
    } catch (e) { console.error('MQTT msg error:', e.message); }
  });
  client.on('error', e => console.error('MQTT error:', e.message));
}
module.exports = { setupMQTT };
```

### FILE: backend/src/services/riskScore.js
```javascript
function calculateRiskScore({ mq2, temperature, humidity, flame, rain }) {
  if (flame === 1) return 95; // instant override
  const gasScore  = Math.min(mq2 / 1000, 1);
  const tempScore = Math.min(Math.max((temperature - 30) / 50, 0), 1);
  const humScore  = humidity < 25 ? (25 - humidity) / 25 : 0;
  const rainScore = rain ? 0.2 : 0;
  const raw = gasScore * 35 + tempScore * 25 + humScore * 10 + rainScore * 5;
  return Math.round(Math.min(raw * 100, 99));
}

function getRiskLevel(score) {
  if (score >= 86) return { level: 'CRITICAL', color: '#ef4444', bg: '#fef2f2' };
  if (score >= 66) return { level: 'DANGER',   color: '#f97316', bg: '#fff7ed' };
  if (score >= 41) return { level: 'WARNING',  color: '#f59e0b', bg: '#fffbeb' };
  return               { level: 'SAFE',     color: '#10b981', bg: '#f0fdf4' };
}

module.exports = { calculateRiskScore, getRiskLevel };
```

### FILE: backend/src/services/alertEngine.js
```javascript
const lastAlertTime = {};
const COOLDOWN_MS = 60000; // 1 min cooldown per sensor+level combo

async function processAlert(sensorData, riskScore, anomaly, io, prisma) {
  const { mq2, temperature, flame } = sensorData;
  let alertType = null;

  if (riskScore >= 86 || flame === 1)           alertType = 'CRITICAL';
  else if (riskScore >= 66)                      alertType = 'DANGER';
  else if (riskScore >= 41 || anomaly?.is_anomaly) alertType = 'WARNING';

  if (!alertType) return;

  let sensor, value, unit, message;
  if (flame === 1)    { sensor = 'Flame Sensor';   value = 1;           unit = '';    message = 'FIRE DETECTED â€” evacuate immediately!'; }
  else if (mq2 > 300) { sensor = 'MQ-2 Gas';       value = mq2;         unit = 'ppm'; message = `Gas level critical: ${mq2} ppm`; }
  else if (temperature > 45) { sensor = 'DHT11 Temp'; value = temperature; unit = 'Â°C'; message = `Temperature critical: ${temperature}Â°C`; }
  else if (anomaly?.is_anomaly) { sensor = 'AI Anomaly'; value = riskScore; unit = ''; message = anomaly.message; }
  else               { sensor = 'Combined';        value = riskScore;   unit = 'risk'; message = `Risk score: ${riskScore}/100`; }

  const key = `${sensor}-${alertType}`;
  const now = Date.now();
  if (lastAlertTime[key] && now - lastAlertTime[key] < COOLDOWN_MS) return;
  lastAlertTime[key] = now;

  const incident = await prisma.incident.create({
    data: { type: alertType, sensor, value, message }
  });

  io.emit('alert', { ...incident, riskScore });

  const payload = { type: alertType, sensor, value, unit, message, riskScore, id: incident.id };

  const { sendTelegramAlert } = require('../alerts/telegram');
  const { sendEmailAlert }    = require('../alerts/email');
  const { logToSheets }       = require('../alerts/sheets');
  const { updateCompliance }  = require('./compliance');

  await Promise.allSettled([
    sendTelegramAlert(payload),
    alertType !== 'WARNING' ? sendEmailAlert(payload) : Promise.resolve(),
    alertType === 'CRITICAL' ? logToSheets(payload) : Promise.resolve(),
    updateCompliance(sensorData.riskLevel, prisma),
  ]);
}

module.exports = { processAlert };
```

### FILE: backend/src/services/thingspeak.js
```javascript
const axios  = require('axios');
const config = require('../config');

async function pushThingSpeak({ mq2, temperature, humidity, flame, rain }) {
  if (!config.THINGSPEAK_WRITE_KEY) return;
  try {
    await axios.get('https://api.thingspeak.com/update', {
      params: { api_key: config.THINGSPEAK_WRITE_KEY, field1: mq2, field2: temperature, field3: humidity, field4: flame, field5: rain }
    });
  } catch (e) { console.error('ThingSpeak error:', e.message); }
}

module.exports = { pushThingSpeak };
```

### FILE: backend/src/services/compliance.js
```javascript
async function updateCompliance(riskLevel, prisma) {
  const today = new Date();
  today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const zone   = 'Zone A';
  const isSafe = riskLevel === 'SAFE';
  await prisma.complianceRecord.upsert({
    where:  { date_zone: { date: today, zone } },
    update: { safeMinutes: isSafe ? { increment: 1 } : undefined, unsafeMinutes: !isSafe ? { increment: 1 } : undefined },
    create: { date: today, zone, safeMinutes: isSafe ? 1 : 0, unsafeMinutes: !isSafe ? 1 : 0 },
  });
}
module.exports = { updateCompliance };
```

const TelegramBot = require('node-telegram-bot-api');
const config      = require('../config');

let bot;

}

```javascript
const express = require('express');
const router  = express.Router();
const { calculateRiskScore, getRiskLevel } = require('../services/riskScore');
const { processAlert }    = require('../services/alertEngine');
const { checkAnomaly }    = require('../services/anomalyClient');
const { writeInflux }     = require('../influx');
const { pushThingSpeak }  = require('../services/thingspeak');
const { updateCompliance } = require('../services/compliance');

router.post('/reading', async (req, res) => {
  const { mq2, temperature, humidity, flame, rain } = req.body;
  const riskScore = calculateRiskScore({ mq2, temperature, humidity, flame, rain });
  const { level: riskLevel } = getRiskLevel(riskScore);
  const anomaly = await checkAnomaly({ mq2, temperature, humidity, flame, rain });
  const data = { mq2, temperature, humidity, flame, rain, riskScore, riskLevel, anomaly, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };

  req.io.emit('sensorUpdate', data);
  await writeInflux(data).catch(e => console.error('InfluxDB write error:', e.message));
  pushThingSpeak({ mq2, temperature, humidity, flame, rain });
  await processAlert(data, riskScore, anomaly, req.io, req.prisma);
  await updateCompliance(riskLevel, req.prisma);

  res.json({ success: true, riskScore, riskLevel });
});

router.get('/latest', async (req, res) => {
  const { queryInflux } = require('../influx');
  try {
    const data = await queryInflux(`from(bucket:"${process.env.INFLUX_BUCKET}")|>range(start:-2m)|>filter(fn:(r)=>r._measurement=="sensor_readings")|>last()`);
    res.json(data);
  } catch (e) { res.status(500).json({ error: e.message }); }
});

module.exports = router;
```

const express = require('express');

router.get('/history', async (req, res) => {
  const { range = '24h' } = req.query;
  const { queryInflux } = require('../influx');

      `from(bucket:"${process.env.INFLUX_BUCKET}")|>range(start:${start})|>filter(fn:(r)=>r._measurement=="sensor_readings")|>aggregateWindow(every:1m,fn:mean,createEmpty:false)`
    );
    res.json(data);
  } catch (e) { res.status(500).json({ error: e.message }); }
});

router.get('/compliance', async (req, res) => {
  const records = await req.prisma.complianceRecord.findMany({ orderBy: { date: 'desc' }, take: 30 });
  const result  = records.map(r => ({
    ...r,
    safePercentage: Math.round((r.safeMinutes / Math.max(r.safeMinutes + r.unsafeMinutes, 1)) * 100),
  }));
  res.json(result);
});

module.exports = router;

## STEP 6 â€” ML ANOMALY DETECTION SERVICE

### FILE: ml-service/model.py
```python
from sklearn.ensemble import IsolationForest
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
import numpy as np
import pickle, os

class HazardAnomalyDetector:
    def __init__(self):
        self.model      = IsolationForest(contamination=0.05, n_estimators=100, random_state=42)
        self.scaler     = StandardScaler()
        self.is_trained = False

    def train(self, readings):
        X = np.array(readings)
        Xs = self.scaler.fit_transform(X)
        self.model.fit(Xs)
        self.is_trained = True
        with open("model.pkl", "wb") as f:
            pickle.dump({"model": self.model, "scaler": self.scaler}, f)

    def load(self):
        if os.path.exists("model.pkl"):
            with open("model.pkl", "rb") as f:
                d = pickle.load(f)
                self.model, self.scaler, self.is_trained = d["model"], d["scaler"], True

    def predict(self, reading):
        if not self.is_trained:
            return {"is_anomaly": False, "anomaly_score": 0.0, "severity": "UNKNOWN", "message": "Model not trained yet"}
        X  = np.array([reading])
        Xs = self.scaler.transform(X)
        pred  = self.model.predict(Xs)[0]
        score = float(self.model.score_samples(Xs)[0])
        is_anomaly = pred == -1
        if is_anomaly:
            severity = "HIGH" if score < -0.6 else "MEDIUM" if score < -0.4 else "LOW"
        else:
            severity = "NONE"
        return {
            "is_anomaly": is_anomaly,
            "anomaly_score": round(score, 4),
            "severity": severity,
            "message": f"Anomaly detected ({severity} severity) â€” potential hazard forming" if is_anomaly else "Readings within normal range",
        }
```

from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel
from model import HazardAnomalyDetector
import uvicorn

app      = FastAPI(title="HazardGuard ML Service")
detector = HazardAnomalyDetector()
detector.load()  # Load saved model on startup if it exists

class SensorReading(BaseModel):
    mq2: float
    temperature: float
    humidity: float
    flame: int
    rain: int

class TrainingData(BaseModel):
    readings: list[list[float]]

@app.post("/train")
def train(data: TrainingData):
    detector.train(data.readings)
    return {"status": "trained", "samples": len(data.readings)}

@app.post("/predict")
def predict(reading: SensorReading):
    return detector.predict([reading.mq2, reading.temperature, reading.humidity, reading.flame, reading.rain])

@app.get("/health")
def health():
    return {"status": "ok", "model_trained": detector.is_trained}

if __name__ == "__main__":
    uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=8000)

### FILE: frontend/hooks/useSensorData.ts
```typescript
'use client';
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { socket }               from '@/lib/socket';
import type { SensorReading, AlertItem } from '@/types';

export function useSensorData() {
  const [current,   setCurrent]   = useState<SensorReading | null>(null);
  const [history,   setHistory]   = useState<SensorReading[]>([]);
  const [alerts,    setAlerts]    = useState<AlertItem[]>([]);
  const [connected, setConnected] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    socket.on('connect',      ()  => setConnected(true));
    socket.on('disconnect',   ()  => setConnected(false));
    socket.on('sensorUpdate', (d: SensorReading) => {
      setCurrent(d);
      setHistory(p => [...p.slice(-59), d]);
    });
    socket.on('alert', (a: AlertItem) => setAlerts(p => [a, ...p].slice(0, 50)));
    return () => { socket.off('connect'); socket.off('disconnect'); socket.off('sensorUpdate'); socket.off('alert'); };
  }, []);

  return { current, history, alerts, connected };
}
```

### FILE: frontend/components/SensorCard.tsx
```tsx
'use client';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';

interface Props {
  label:      string;
  sensor:     string;
  value?:     number;
  unit:       string;
  thresholds: { warning?: number; danger?: number; critical?: number };
  icon:       string;
  invert?:    boolean;
  binary?:    boolean;
}

function status(v: number, t: Props['thresholds'], invert?: boolean, binary?: boolean) {
  if (binary) return v === 1 ? 'CRITICAL' : 'SAFE';
  if (invert) {
    if (t.critical !== undefined && v <= t.critical) return 'CRITICAL';
    if (t.danger   !== undefined && v <= t.danger)   return 'DANGER';
    if (t.warning  !== undefined && v <= t.warning)  return 'WARNING';
  } else {
    if (t.critical !== undefined && v >= t.critical) return 'CRITICAL';
    if (t.danger   !== undefined && v >= t.danger)   return 'DANGER';
    if (t.warning  !== undefined && v >= t.warning)  return 'WARNING';
  }
  return 'SAFE';
}

const CFG = {
  SAFE:     { ring: 'border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50/40', dot: 'bg-emerald-500',            badge: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700' },
  WARNING:  { ring: 'border-amber-200  bg-amber-50/40',   dot: 'bg-amber-500  animate-pulse', badge: 'bg-amber-100  text-amber-700'  },
  DANGER:   { ring: 'border-orange-200 bg-orange-50/40',  dot: 'bg-orange-500 animate-pulse', badge: 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700' },
  CRITICAL: { ring: 'border-red-300    bg-red-50/50',     dot: 'bg-red-500    animate-ping',  badge: 'bg-red-100    text-red-700'   },
};

export function SensorCard({ label, sensor, value, unit, thresholds, icon, invert, binary }: Props) {
  const s   = value !== undefined ? status(value, thresholds, invert, binary) : 'SAFE';
  const cfg = CFG[s];
  const display = binary ? (value === 1 ? 'DETECTED' : 'CLEAR') : (value?.toFixed(1) ?? 'â€”');

  return (
    <motion.div layout className={`rounded-xl border-2 ${cfg.ring} p-5 transition-all duration-500 bg-white shadow-sm`}>
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-4">
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-widest">{label}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-300 mt-0.5">{sensor}</p>
        </div>
        <span className={`text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-full flex items-center gap-1.5 ${cfg.badge}`}>
          <span className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${cfg.dot}`} />
          {s}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-end gap-1.5">
        <span className="text-4xl font-black text-slate-900 leading-none">{display}</span>
        {!binary && <span className="text-sm text-slate-400 mb-1">{unit}</span>}
      </div>
      <div className="mt-4 text-3xl">{icon}</div>
    </motion.div>
  );
}
```

};

export function RiskGauge({ score, level }: { score: number; level: string }) {
  const cfg = LEVEL_CFG[level as keyof typeof LEVEL_CFG] ?? LEVEL_CFG.SAFE;

  const options = {
    chart: { type: 'radialBar' as const, background: 'transparent' },
    plotOptions: {
      radialBar: {

        },
      },
    },
    fill:   { colors: [cfg.color] },
    labels: ['Risk Score'],
    stroke: { lineCap: 'round' as const },
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
      <Chart options={options} series={[score]} type="radialBar" width={250} height={250} />
      <motion.p key={level} initial={{ scale: 0.8, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }}
        className={`text-lg font-bold ${cfg.bg}`}>
        {cfg.label}
      </motion.p>
    </div>
  );
}

  DANGER:   { bar: 'border-l-orange-500', bg: 'bg-orange-50', icon: 'ðŸ”¥', text: 'text-orange-800' },

};

export function AlertFeed({ alerts }: { alerts: AlertItem[] }) {
  if (!alerts.length) return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-44 text-slate-300">
      <span className="text-4xl mb-2">âœ…</span>
      <p className="text-sm">No alerts â€” all systems nominal</p>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2 max-h-64 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
      <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
        {alerts.map(a => {
          const cfg = CFG[a.type] ?? CFG.WARNING;
          return (
            <motion.div key={a.id} initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -16 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
              className={`${cfg.bg} border border-transparent border-l-4 ${cfg.bar} rounded-lg px-4 py-3`}>
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
                  <span className="mt-0.5">{cfg.icon}</span>
                  <div>
                    <p className={`text-sm font-bold ${cfg.text}`}>{a.type} â€” {a.sensor}</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 mt-0.5">{a.message}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right shrink-0">
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">{fmtTime(a.createdAt)}</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium mt-0.5">Risk {a.riskScore}/100</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          );
        })}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';
import dynamic from 'next/dynamic';
const Chart = dynamic(() => import('react-apexcharts'), { ssr: false });

interface Props {
  title:      string;
  data:       { x: string; y: number }[];
  color:      string;
  unit:       string;
  dangerLine?: number;
}

export function SensorChart({ title, data, color, unit, dangerLine }: Props) {
  const annotations: any = dangerLine ? {
    yaxis: [{ y: dangerLine, borderColor: '#ef4444', strokeDashArray: 5,
      label: { text: `âš  ${dangerLine}${unit}`, style: { color: '#fff', background: '#ef4444', fontSize: '10px' } } }]
  } : {};

  const options = {
    chart:    { type: 'area' as const, background: 'transparent', toolbar: { show: false }, animations: { enabled: true, easing: 'linear', dynamicAnimation: { speed: 600 } } },
    stroke:   { curve: 'smooth' as const, width: 2 },
    fill:     { type: 'gradient', gradient: { shadeIntensity: 1, opacityFrom: 0.25, opacityTo: 0.02 } },
    colors:   [color],
    xaxis:    { type: 'datetime' as const, labels: { style: { colors: '#94a3b8', fontSize: '10px' } }, axisBorder: { show: false }, axisTicks: { show: false } },
    yaxis:    { labels: { style: { colors: '#94a3b8', fontSize: '10px' }, formatter: (v: number) => `${v.toFixed(0)}${unit}` } },
    grid:     { borderColor: '#f1f5f9', strokeDashArray: 3 },
    tooltip:  { x: { format: 'HH:mm:ss' }, y: { formatter: (v: number) => `${v.toFixed(2)} ${unit}` } },
    dataLabels: { enabled: false },
    annotations,
  };

  return (
    <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-5">
      <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-3">{title}</h3>
      <Chart options={options}
        series={[{ name: title, data: data.map(d => ({ x: new Date(d.x).getTime(), y: d.y })) }]}
        type="area" height={180} />
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import type { SensorReading } from '@/types';

const ZONES = [
  { id: 'Z-A', name: 'Storage',    sensor: 'mq2' as keyof SensorReading,         x: 60,  y: 55,  w: 170, h: 115, thresholds: { w: 200, c: 400 } },
  { id: 'Z-B', name: 'Assembly',   sensor: 'temperature' as keyof SensorReading,  x: 270, y: 55,  w: 170, h: 115, thresholds: { w: 38,  c: 50  } },
  { id: 'Z-C', name: 'Generator',  sensor: 'flame' as keyof SensorReading,        x: 60,  y: 210, w: 170, h: 115, thresholds: { c: 1   } },
  { id: 'Z-D', name: 'Electrical', sensor: 'rain' as keyof SensorReading,         x: 270, y: 210, w: 170, h: 115, thresholds: { w: 1   } },
];

function getStatus(zone: typeof ZONES[0], data: SensorReading | null) {
  if (!data) return 'SAFE';
  const v = data[zone.sensor] as number;
  if (zone.thresholds.c !== undefined && v >= zone.thresholds.c) return 'CRITICAL';
  if (zone.thresholds.w !== undefined && v >= zone.thresholds.w) return 'WARNING';
  return 'SAFE';
}

const C = {
  SAFE:     { fill: '#dcfce7', stroke: '#16a34a', text: '#15803d' },
  WARNING:  { fill: '#fef9c3', stroke: '#ca8a04', text: '#92400e' },
  DANGER:   { fill: '#ffedd5', stroke: '#ea580c', text: '#c2410c' },
  CRITICAL: { fill: '#fee2e2', stroke: '#dc2626', text: '#991b1b' },
};

const sensorLabel = (zone: typeof ZONES[0], data: SensorReading | null) => {
  if (!data) return 'â€”';
  const v = data[zone.sensor];
  if (zone.sensor === 'mq2')         return `${(v as number).toFixed(0)} ppm`;
  if (zone.sensor === 'temperature') return `${(v as number).toFixed(1)}Â°C`;
  if (zone.sensor === 'flame')       return v ? 'ðŸ”¥ FIRE' : 'âœ… Clear';
  if (zone.sensor === 'rain')        return v ? 'ðŸ’§ Wet' : 'âœ… Dry';
  return 'â€”';
};

export function FloorMap({ data }: { data: SensorReading | null }) {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 500 360" className="w-full max-w-2xl mx-auto">
      <rect x="40" y="35" width="420" height="300" rx="10" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#e2e8f0" strokeWidth="2" />
      <text x="250" y="25" textAnchor="middle" fill="#94a3b8" fontSize="11" fontWeight="600">FACTORY FLOOR â€” ZONE OVERVIEW</text>
      {ZONES.map(zone => {
        const s = getStatus(zone, data);
        const c = C[s] ?? C.SAFE;
        return (
          <g key={zone.id}>
            <rect x={zone.x} y={zone.y} width={zone.w} height={zone.h} rx="8" fill={c.fill} stroke={c.stroke} strokeWidth="2" />
            {s === 'CRITICAL' && (
              <rect x={zone.x} y={zone.y} width={zone.w} height={zone.h} rx="8" fill="none" stroke={c.stroke} strokeWidth="3" opacity="0.6">
                <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.6;1;0.6" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
              </rect>
            )}
            <text x={zone.x + zone.w / 2} y={zone.y + 30} textAnchor="middle" fill={c.text} fontSize="12" fontWeight="800">{zone.id}</text>
            <text x={zone.x + zone.w / 2} y={zone.y + 50} textAnchor="middle" fill={c.text} fontSize="10">{zone.name}</text>
            <text x={zone.x + zone.w / 2} y={zone.y + 72} textAnchor="middle" fill={c.stroke} fontSize="11" fontWeight="700">{s}</text>
            <text x={zone.x + zone.w / 2} y={zone.y + 92} textAnchor="middle" fill="#475569" fontSize="10">{sensorLabel(zone, data)}</text>
          </g>
        );
      })}
      {/* Legend */}
      {Object.entries(C).map(([s, c], i) => (
        <g key={s} transform={`translate(${55 + i * 100}, 340)`}>
          <rect width="10" height="10" rx="2" fill={c.fill} stroke={c.stroke} strokeWidth="1.5" />
          <text x="14" y="9" fill="#64748b" fontSize="9" fontWeight="500">{s}</text>
        </g>
      ))}
    </svg>
  );
}

'use client';
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import dynamic                 from 'next/dynamic';
import { fetchHistory, fetchCompliance } from '@/lib/api';
import type { ComplianceRecord }         from '@/types';

const Chart = dynamic(() => import('react-apexcharts'), { ssr: false });

export default function AnalyticsPage() {
  const [history,    setHistory]    = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [compliance, setCompliance] = useState<ComplianceRecord[]>([]);
  const [range,      setRange]      = useState('24h');

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchHistory(range).then(setHistory);
    fetchCompliance().then(setCompliance);
  }, [range]);

  const makeData = (field: string) =>
    history.filter(h => h._field === field).map(h => ({ x: new Date(h._time).getTime(), y: h._value }));

  const areaOpts = (color: string, unit: string, dangerLine?: number) => ({
    chart:       { type: 'area' as const, background: 'transparent', toolbar: { show: false } },
    colors:      [color],
    stroke:      { curve: 'smooth' as const, width: 2 },
    fill:        { type: 'gradient', gradient: { opacityFrom: 0.25, opacityTo: 0.02 } },
    xaxis:       { type: 'datetime' as const, labels: { style: { colors: '#94a3b8', fontSize: '10px' } } },
    yaxis:       { labels: { style: { colors: '#94a3b8', fontSize: '10px' }, formatter: (v: number) => `${v.toFixed(0)}${unit}` } },
    grid:        { borderColor: '#f1f5f9', strokeDashArray: 3 },
    dataLabels:  { enabled: false },
    annotations: dangerLine ? { yaxis: [{ y: dangerLine, borderColor: '#ef4444', strokeDashArray: 4, label: { text: 'Danger', style: { color: '#fff', background: '#ef4444', fontSize: '9px' } } }] } : {},
  });

  return (
    <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900">Analytics</h1>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          {['1h','6h','24h','7d'].map(r => (
            <button key={r} onClick={() => setRange(r)}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium rounded-lg transition-colors ${range === r ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white' : 'bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50'}`}>
              {r}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Charts */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        {[
          { title: 'Risk Score',       field: 'risk_score',  color: '#8b5cf6', unit: '/100', danger: 66  },
          { title: 'Gas Level (MQ-2)', field: 'mq2',         color: '#3b82f6', unit: 'ppm',  danger: 400 },
          { title: 'Temperature',      field: 'temperature', color: '#f97316', unit: 'Â°C',   danger: 45  },
          { title: 'Humidity',         field: 'humidity',    color: '#06b6d4', unit: '%' },
        ].map(({ title, field, color, unit, danger }) => (
          <div key={field} className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-sm p-5">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-3">{title}</h3>
            <Chart options={areaOpts(color, unit, danger)} series={[{ name: title, data: makeData(field) }]} type="area" height={180} />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Compliance Table */}
      <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-800">Safety Compliance Log</h3>
          <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">Last 30 days</span>

        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full">
            <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
              <tr>
                {['Date','Zone','Safe Time','Unsafe Time','Compliance'].map(h => (
                  <th key={h} className="text-left px-5 py-3">{h}</th>
                ))}
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 text-sm">
              {compliance.map((r, i) => (
                <tr key={i} className="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">
                  <td className="px-5 py-3 text-slate-600">{new Date(r.date).toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}</td>
                  <td className="px-5 py-3 text-slate-700 font-medium">{r.zone}</td>
                  <td className="px-5 py-3 text-emerald-700 font-medium">{r.safeMinutes}m</td>
                  <td className="px-5 py-3 text-red-600 font-medium">{r.unsafeMinutes}m</td>
                  <td className="px-5 py-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <div className="flex-1 h-2 bg-slate-100 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                        <div className="h-full bg-emerald-500 rounded-full transition-all" style={{ width: `${r.safePercentage}%` }} />

              )}

          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion }              from 'framer-motion';
import jsPDF                   from 'jspdf';
import autoTable               from 'jspdf-autotable';
import { fetchIncidents, acknowledgeAlert } from '@/lib/api';
import { fmtFull }             from '@/lib/utils';
import type { Incident }       from '@/types';

const TYPE_CFG = {
  WARNING:  { badge: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800',  dot: 'bg-amber-500',  icon: 'âš ï¸' },
  DANGER:   { badge: 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800',dot: 'bg-orange-500', icon: 'ðŸ”¥' },
  CRITICAL: { badge: 'bg-red-100 text-red-800',      dot: 'bg-red-500',    icon: 'ðŸš¨' },
};

function downloadPDF(incident: Incident) {
  const doc = new jsPDF();
  doc.setFillColor(30, 64, 175);
  doc.rect(0, 0, 210, 38, 'F');
  doc.setTextColor(255, 255, 255);
  doc.setFontSize(18); doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
  doc.text('INDUSTRIAL HAZARD INCIDENT REPORT', 15, 17);
  doc.setFontSize(9);  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
  doc.text('HazardGuard Industrial Safety System', 15, 26);
  doc.text(`Generated: ${new Date().toLocaleString()}`, 15, 33);
  doc.setTextColor(0, 0, 0);
  autoTable(doc, {
    startY: 48,
    head: [['Field', 'Value']],
    body: [
      ['Incident ID',   incident.id],
      ['Alert Type',    incident.type],
      ['Sensor',        incident.sensor],
      ['Reading Value', `${incident.value}`],
      ['Message',       incident.message],
      ['Date & Time',   fmtFull(incident.createdAt)],
      ['Status',        incident.acknowledged ? 'Acknowledged' : 'Pending Review'],
    ],
    headStyles:         { fillColor: [30, 64, 175], fontStyle: 'bold' },
    alternateRowStyles: { fillColor: [248, 250, 252] },
    styles:             { fontSize: 11, cellPadding: 6 },
  });
  doc.save(`incident-${incident.id.slice(0, 8)}.pdf`);
}

export default function IncidentsPage() {
  const [incidents, setIncidents] = useState<Incident[]>([]);
  const [filter,    setFilter]    = useState('ALL');

  useEffect(() => { fetchIncidents().then(setIncidents); }, []);

  const handleAck = async (id: string) => {
    await acknowledgeAlert(id);
    setIncidents(p => p.map(i => i.id === id ? { ...i, acknowledged: true } : i));
  };

  const filtered = filter === 'ALL' ? incidents : incidents.filter(i => i.type === filter);

  return (
    <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-6">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">

===== FILE: D:\IOE\README.md =====
# HazardGuard

Industrial hazard detection dashboard with a Node.js/Socket.io backend, Next.js frontend, optional Isolation Forest service, and HTTP sensor simulator.

## Local run

1. Install Node.js 18+ and Python 3.10+.
2. In `backend`, run `npm install` then `npm run dev`.
3. In `frontend`, run `npm install` then copy `.env.local.example` to `.env.local` and run `npm run dev`.
4. In `simulator`, run `npm install` then `npm start`.
5. Open http://localhost:3000.

### Sending real sensor data

For the Arduino/ESP live path, the ESP should publish JSON to MQTT topic `hazard/sensors`. The backend subscribes to that topic and forwards every reading through risk scoring, alerts, persistence, and Socket.io to the dashboard.

In `backend/.env`, configure the broker used by the ESP:

```env
MQTT_ENABLED=true
MQTT_BROKER=mqtt://broker.hivemq.com
MQTT_TOPIC=hazard/sensors
MQTT_USERNAME=
MQTT_PASSWORD=
```

Start the backend with `npm start`. A successful connection logs `MQTT connected` and each received packet logs `MQTT reading received`. The ESP payload should contain `mq2`, `temperature`, `humidity`, `flame`, and `rain`.

The simulator can replay a JSON or CSV export to the backend. Set `DATA_FILE` to the file path:

```powershell
cd simulator
$env:BACKEND_URL = 'http://localhost:4000'
$env:DATA_FILE = 'D:\path\to\sensor-data.json'
$env:INTERVAL_MS = '2000'
npm start
```

JSON may be an array of readings or `{ "readings": [...] }`. CSV must have a header row. The canonical fields are `mq2`, `temperature`, `humidity`, `flame`, and `rain`; common aliases (`gas_ppm`, `temp`, `fire`, and `rain_detected`) are also accepted. Each record is posted to `/api/sensors/reading`.

The backend starts without Postgres, InfluxDB, or ML credentials by using an in-memory development store. Set `backend/.env` from `.env.example` to enable cloud integrations. The ML service is optional; install `ml-service/requirements.txt`, run `python main.py`, then `python train.py`.

const { InfluxDB, Point } = require('@influxdata/influxdb-client');
const config = require('./config');
const localReadings = [];
const enabled = Boolean(config.INFLUX_URL && config.INFLUX_TOKEN && config.INFLUX_ORG);
const client = enabled ? new InfluxDB({ url: config.INFLUX_URL, token: config.INFLUX_TOKEN }) : null;
const writeApi = client?.getWriteApi(config.INFLUX_ORG, config.INFLUX_BUCKET, 'ns');
const queryApi = client?.getQueryApi(config.INFLUX_ORG);

async function writeInflux(data) {
  localReadings.push(data);
  if (localReadings.length > 1000) localReadings.shift();
  if (!writeApi) return;
  const point = new Point('sensor_readings')
    .floatField('mq2', data.mq2).floatField('temperature', data.temperature)
    .floatField('humidity', data.humidity).intField('flame', data.flame)
    .intField('rain', data.rain).intField('risk_score', data.riskScore)
    .tag('level', data.riskLevel).timestamp(new Date(data.timestamp));
  writeApi.writePoint(point);
  await writeApi.flush();
}

async function queryInflux(fluxQuery) {
  if (!queryApi) return localReadings.map((reading) => ({ ...reading, _time: reading.timestamp, _measurement: 'sensor_readings' }));
  const results = [];
  await queryApi.collectRows(fluxQuery, (row, tableMeta) => results.push(tableMeta.toObject(row)));
  return results;
}

module.exports = { writeInflux, queryInflux };

const mqtt = require('mqtt');
const config = require('../config');
const { processReading } = require('../services/readingPipeline');

function setupMQTT(io, prismaOrGetter) {
  if (!config.MQTT_ENABLED) return null;
  const client = mqtt.connect(config.MQTT_BROKER, {
    username: config.MQTT_USERNAME,
    password: config.MQTT_PASSWORD,
    reconnectPeriod: 5000,
    connectTimeout: 10000,
    clientId: `hazardguard-backend-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2, 10)}`
  });
  client.on('connect', () => {
    console.log(`MQTT connected: ${config.MQTT_BROKER}, subscribing to ${config.MQTT_TOPIC}`);
    client.subscribe(config.MQTT_TOPIC, (error) => {
      if (error) console.error('MQTT subscription error:', error.message);
    });
  });
  client.on('message', async (topic, message) => {
    try {
      const payload = JSON.parse(message.toString());
      console.log(`MQTT reading received on ${topic}:`, payload);
      const prisma = typeof prismaOrGetter === 'function' ? prismaOrGetter() : prismaOrGetter;
      const reading = await processReading(payload, { io, prisma });
      console.log('MQTT reading processed:', reading.riskLevel, `${reading.riskScore}/100`);
    }
    catch (error) { console.error('MQTT message error:', error.message, message.toString()); }
  });
  client.on('error', (error) => console.error('MQTT error:', error.message));
  return client;
}
module.exports = { setupMQTT };

const lastAlertTime = new Map();
const cooldownMs = 60_000;

function createMemoryStore() {
  const incidents = [];
  const compliance = new Map();
  return {
    incident: {
      async create({ data }) { const incident = { id: `local-${Date.now()}-${incidents.length}`, ...data, acknowledged: false, createdAt: new Date().toISOString() }; incidents.unshift(incident); return incident; },
      async findMany({ take = 100 } = {}) { return incidents.slice(0, take); },
      async update({ where, data }) { const item = incidents.find((incident) => incident.id === where.id); if (!item) throw new Error('Incident not found'); Object.assign(item, data); return item; },
    },
    complianceRecord: {
      async findMany({ take = 30 } = {}) { return [...compliance.values()].slice(0, take); },
      async upsert({ create, update }) { const key = `${create.date.toISOString()}-${create.zone}`; const item = compliance.get(key) || { id: `local-${key}`, ...create }; if (compliance.has(key)) Object.assign(item, update.safeMinutes ? { safeMinutes: item.safeMinutes + 1 } : { unsafeMinutes: item.unsafeMinutes + 1 }); compliance.set(key, item); return item; },
    },
  };
}

const memoryStore = createMemoryStore();
function getStore(prisma) { return prisma || memoryStore; }

async function processAlert(sensorData, prisma, io) {
  const { riskScore, anomaly, mq2, temperature, flame } = sensorData;
  let type = null;
  if (riskScore >= 86 || flame === 1) type = 'CRITICAL';
  else if (riskScore >= 66) type = 'DANGER';
  else if (riskScore >= 41 || anomaly?.is_anomaly) type = 'WARNING';
  if (!type) return null;

  let sensor = 'Combined'; let value = riskScore; let message = `Risk score: ${riskScore}/100`;
  if (flame === 1) { sensor = 'Flame Sensor'; value = 1; message = 'Fire detected - evacuate immediately.'; }
  else if (mq2 > 300) { sensor = 'MQ-2 Gas'; value = mq2; message = `Gas level elevated: ${mq2} ppm`; }
  else if (temperature > 45) { sensor = 'DHT11 Temp'; value = temperature; message = `Temperature elevated: ${temperature} C`; }
  else if (anomaly?.is_anomaly) { sensor = 'AI Anomaly'; message = anomaly.message; }

  const key = `${sensor}-${type}`; const now = Date.now();
  if (lastAlertTime.has(key) && now - lastAlertTime.get(key) < cooldownMs) return null;
  lastAlertTime.set(key, now);
  const incident = await getStore(prisma).incident.create({ data: { type, sensor, value, message } });
  io?.emit('alert', { ...incident, riskScore });
  const payload = { type, sensor, value, message, riskScore, id: incident.id };
  const { sendTelegramAlert } = require('../alerts/telegram');
  const { sendEmailAlert } = require('../alerts/email');
  const { logToSheets } = require('../alerts/sheets');
  await Promise.allSettled([
    sendTelegramAlert(payload),
    type === 'WARNING' ? Promise.resolve() : sendEmailAlert(payload),
    type === 'CRITICAL' ? logToSheets(payload) : Promise.resolve(),
  ]);
  return incident;
}

module.exports = { processAlert, getStore };

async function checkAnomaly(readings) {

    const response = await axios.post(`${config.ML_SERVICE_URL}/predict`, readings, { timeout: 1500 });

  } catch {
    return { is_anomaly: false, anomaly_score: 0, severity: 'UNKNOWN', message: 'AI service offline' };
  }
}

async function updateCompliance(riskLevel, prisma) {
  if (!prisma) return;
  const date = new Date();
  date.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const safe = riskLevel === 'SAFE';
  await prisma.complianceRecord.upsert({
    where: { date_zone: { date, zone: 'Zone A' } },
    update: safe ? { safeMinutes: { increment: 1 } } : { unsafeMinutes: { increment: 1 } },
    create: { date, zone: 'Zone A', safeMinutes: safe ? 1 : 0, unsafeMinutes: safe ? 0 : 1 },
  });
}
module.exports = { updateCompliance };

===== FILE: D:\IOE\backend\src\services\readingPipeline.js =====
const { calculateRiskScore, getRiskLevel } = require('./riskScore');
const { checkAnomaly } = require('./anomalyClient');
const { writeInflux } = require('../influx');
const { processAlert } = require('./alertEngine');
const { updateCompliance } = require('./compliance');
const { pushThingSpeak } = require('./thingspeak');

function normalizeReading(input) {
  const source = input?.data && typeof input.data === 'object' ? input.data : input;
  const get = (...keys) => keys.map((key) => source?.[key]).find((value) => value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== '');
  const reading = {
    mq2: Number(get('mq2', 'gas', 'gas_ppm', 'smoke') ?? 0),
    temperature: Number(get('temperature', 'temp', 'temperature_c') ?? 0),
    humidity: Number(get('humidity', 'humidity_percent') ?? 0),
    flame: Number(get('flame', 'fire') ?? 0),
    rain: Number(get('rain', 'rain_detected') ?? 0)
  };
  if (!Object.values(reading).every(Number.isFinite)) throw new Error('Sensor values must be numeric');
  return reading;
}

async function processReading(input, { io, prisma }) {
  const reading = normalizeReading(input);
  const riskScore = calculateRiskScore(reading);
  const riskLevel = getRiskLevel(riskScore).level;
  const anomaly = await checkAnomaly(reading);
  const data = { ...reading, riskScore, riskLevel, anomaly, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };
  io?.emit('sensorUpdate', data);
  await writeInflux(data).catch((error) => console.error('History write error:', error.message));
  await pushThingSpeak(reading);
  await processAlert(data, prisma, io);
  await updateCompliance(riskLevel, prisma).catch((error) => console.error('Compliance error:', error.message));
  return data;
}
module.exports = { processReading };

===== FILE: D:\IOE\backend\src\services\riskScore.js =====
function calculateRiskScore({ mq2 = 0, temperature = 0, humidity = 50, flame = 0, rain = 0 }) {
  if (Number(flame) === 1) return 95;
  const gasScore = Math.min(Number(mq2) / 1000, 1);
  const tempScore = Math.min(Math.max((Number(temperature) - 30) / 50, 0), 1);
  const humidityScore = Number(humidity) < 25 ? (25 - Number(humidity)) / 25 : 0;
  const rainScore = Number(rain) ? 0.2 : 0;
  return Math.round(Math.min((gasScore * 35 + tempScore * 25 + humidityScore * 10 + rainScore * 5), 99));
}

function getRiskLevel(score) {
  if (score >= 86) return { level: 'CRITICAL', color: '#dc2626', bg: '#fef2f2' };
  if (score >= 66) return { level: 'DANGER', color: '#ea580c', bg: '#fff7ed' };
  if (score >= 41) return { level: 'WARNING', color: '#d97706', bg: '#fffbeb' };
  return { level: 'SAFE', color: '#059669', bg: '#ecfdf5' };
}

module.exports = { calculateRiskScore, getRiskLevel };

const axios = require('axios');
const config = require('../config');

async function pushThingSpeak({ mq2, temperature, humidity, flame, rain }) {
  if (!config.THINGSPEAK_WRITE_KEY) return;
  try {
    await axios.get('https://api.thingspeak.com/update', { params: { api_key: config.THINGSPEAK_WRITE_KEY, field1: mq2, field2: temperature, field3: humidity, field4: flame, field5: rain } });
  } catch (error) { console.error('ThingSpeak error:', error.message); }
}
module.exports = { pushThingSpeak };

===== FILE: D:\IOE\backend\src\socket\socketHandler.js =====
function setupSocket(io, store) {
  io.on('connection', async (socket) => {
    const incidents = await store.incident.findMany({ take: 20 });
    incidents.reverse().forEach((incident) => socket.emit('alert', incident));
    console.log('Client connected:', socket.id);
  });
}
module.exports = { setupSocket };

// File: D:\IOE\frontend\app\layout.tsx
import * as entry from '../../../app/layout.js'
import type { ResolvingMetadata, ResolvingViewport } from 'next/dist/lib/metadata/types/metadata-interface.js'

type TEntry = typeof import('../../../app/layout.js')

// Check that the entry is a valid entry
checkFields<Diff<{
  default: Function
  config?: {}
  generateStaticParams?: Function
  revalidate?: RevalidateRange<TEntry> | false
  dynamic?: 'auto' | 'force-dynamic' | 'error' | 'force-static'
  dynamicParams?: boolean
  fetchCache?: 'auto' | 'force-no-store' | 'only-no-store' | 'default-no-store' | 'default-cache' | 'only-cache' | 'force-cache'
  preferredRegion?: 'auto' | 'global' | 'home' | string | string[]
  runtime?: 'nodejs' | 'experimental-edge' | 'edge'
  maxDuration?: number
  
  metadata?: any
  generateMetadata?: Function
  viewport?: any
  generateViewport?: Function
  
}, TEntry, ''>>()

// Check the prop type of the entry function
checkFields<Diff<LayoutProps, FirstArg<TEntry['default']>, 'default'>>()

// Check the arguments and return type of the generateMetadata function
if ('generateMetadata' in entry) {
  checkFields<Diff<LayoutProps, FirstArg<MaybeField<TEntry, 'generateMetadata'>>, 'generateMetadata'>>()
  checkFields<Diff<ResolvingMetadata, SecondArg<MaybeField<TEntry, 'generateMetadata'>>, 'generateMetadata'>>()
}

// Check the arguments and return type of the generateViewport function
if ('generateViewport' in entry) {
  checkFields<Diff<LayoutProps, FirstArg<MaybeField<TEntry, 'generateViewport'>>, 'generateViewport'>>()
  checkFields<Diff<ResolvingViewport, SecondArg<MaybeField<TEntry, 'generateViewport'>>, 'generateViewport'>>()
}

// Check the arguments and return type of the generateStaticParams function
if ('generateStaticParams' in entry) {
  checkFields<Diff<{ params: PageParams }, FirstArg<MaybeField<TEntry, 'generateStaticParams'>>, 'generateStaticParams'>>()
  checkFields<Diff<{ __tag__: 'generateStaticParams', __return_type__: any[] | Promise<any[]> }, { __tag__: 'generateStaticParams', __return_type__: ReturnType<MaybeField<TEntry, 'generateStaticParams'>> }>>()
}

type PageParams = any
export interface PageProps {
  params?: any
  searchParams?: any
}
export interface LayoutProps {
  children?: React.ReactNode

  params?: any
}

// =============
// Utility types
type RevalidateRange<T> = T extends { revalidate: any } ? NonNegative<T['revalidate']> : never

// If T is unknown or any, it will be an empty {} type. Otherwise, it will be the same as Omit<T, keyof Base>.
type OmitWithTag<T, K extends keyof any, _M> = Omit<T, K>
type Diff<Base, T extends Base, Message extends string = ''> = 0 extends (1 & T) ? {} : OmitWithTag<T, keyof Base, Message>

type FirstArg<T extends Function> = T extends (...args: [infer T, any]) => any ? unknown extends T ? any : T : never
type SecondArg<T extends Function> = T extends (...args: [any, infer T]) => any ? unknown extends T ? any : T : never
type MaybeField<T, K extends string> = T extends { [k in K]: infer G } ? G extends Function ? G : never : never



function checkFields<_ extends { [k in keyof any]: never }>() {}

// https://github.com/sindresorhus/type-fest
type Numeric = number | bigint
type Zero = 0 | 0n
type Negative<T extends Numeric> = T extends Zero ? never : `${T}` extends `-${string}` ? T : never
type NonNegative<T extends Numeric> = T extends Zero ? T : Negative<T> extends never ? T : '__invalid_negative_number__'

from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel
import uvicorn
from model import HazardAnomalyDetector

app = FastAPI(title='HazardGuard ML Service')
detector = HazardAnomalyDetector()
detector.load()

class SensorReading(BaseModel):
    mq2: float
    temperature: float
    humidity: float
    flame: int
    rain: int

class TrainingData(BaseModel):
    readings: list[list[float]]

@app.post('/train')
def train(data: TrainingData):
    detector.train(data.readings)
    return {'status': 'trained', 'samples': len(data.readings)}

@app.post('/predict')
def predict(reading: SensorReading):
    result = detector.predict([
        reading.mq2, 
        reading.temperature, 
        reading.humidity, 
        reading.flame, 
        reading.rain
    ])
    
    # Safely convert NumPy types to native Python types for FastAPI serialization
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        return {k: (v.item() if hasattr(v, 'item') else v) for k, v in result.items()}
    elif hasattr(result, 'item'):
        return result.item()
    elif hasattr(result, 'tolist'):
        return result.tolist()
        
    return result

@app.get('/health')
def health():
    return {'status': 'ok', 'model_trained': detector.is_trained}

if __name__ == '__main__':
    uvicorn.run(app, host='0.0.0.0', port=8000)

from pathlib import Path
import pickle
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import IsolationForest
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

MODEL_PATH = Path(__file__).with_name('model.pkl')
class HazardAnomalyDetector:
    def __init__(self):
        self.model = IsolationForest(contamination=0.05, n_estimators=100, random_state=42)
        self.scaler = StandardScaler()
        self.is_trained = False
    def train(self, readings):
        values = np.asarray(readings, dtype=float)
        self.scaler.fit(values); self.model.fit(self.scaler.transform(values)); self.is_trained = True
        with MODEL_PATH.open('wb') as file: pickle.dump({'model': self.model, 'scaler': self.scaler}, file)
    def load(self):
        if MODEL_PATH.exists():
            with MODEL_PATH.open('rb') as file: saved = pickle.load(file)
            self.model, self.scaler, self.is_trained = saved['model'], saved['scaler'], True
    def predict(self, reading):
        if not self.is_trained: return {'is_anomaly': False, 'anomaly_score': 0.0, 'severity': 'UNKNOWN', 'message': 'Model not trained yet'}
        values = self.scaler.transform(np.asarray([reading], dtype=float)); prediction = self.model.predict(values)[0]; score = float(self.model.score_samples(values)[0]); anomaly = prediction == -1
        severity = 'HIGH' if score < -0.6 else 'MEDIUM' if score < -0.4 else 'LOW' if anomaly else 'NONE'
        return {'is_anomaly': anomaly, 'anomaly_score': round(score, 4), 'severity': severity, 'message': f'Anomaly detected ({severity} severity) - potential hazard forming' if anomaly else 'Readings within normal range'}

require('dotenv').config();
const axios = require('axios');
const fs = require('fs');
const { generateNormal, generateWarning, generateCritical, generateGradualSpike, resetGas } = require('./sensors');
const backendUrl = process.env.BACKEND_URL || 'http://localhost:4000';
const intervalMs = Number(process.env.INTERVAL_MS || 2000);
const dataFile = process.env.DATA_FILE;
const scenario = [{ mode: 'normal', duration: 15 }, { mode: 'spike', duration: 20 }, { mode: 'warning', duration: 10 }, { mode: 'critical', duration: 8 }, { mode: 'normal', duration: 12 }];
let scenarioIndex = 0; let count = 0;
let realReadings = dataFile ? loadReadings(dataFile) : null;
let realIndex = 0;

function number(value, name) {
  const result = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(result)) throw new Error(`Invalid ${name} value: ${value}`);
  return result;
}

function normalizeReading(input) {
  const value = (keys) => keys.map((key) => input[key]).find((item) => item !== undefined && item !== null && item !== '');
  return {
    mq2: number(value(['mq2', 'gas', 'gas_ppm', 'smoke']), 'mq2'),
    temperature: number(value(['temperature', 'temp', 'temperature_c']), 'temperature'),
    humidity: number(value(['humidity', 'humidity_percent']), 'humidity'),
    flame: number(value(['flame', 'fire']) ?? 0, 'flame'),
    rain: number(value(['rain', 'rain_detected']) ?? 0, 'rain')
  };
}

function loadReadings(file) {
  const content = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8').trim();
  if (!content) throw new Error(`Sensor data file is empty: ${file}`);
  if (file.toLowerCase().endsWith('.json')) {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(content);
    const rows = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : parsed.readings;
    if (!Array.isArray(rows)) throw new Error('JSON must contain an array or a readings array');
    return rows.map(normalizeReading);
  }
  const lines = content.split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean);
  const headers = lines.shift().split(',').map((header) => header.trim());
  return lines.map((line) => normalizeReading(Object.fromEntries(line.split(',').map((item, index) => [headers[index], item.trim()]))));
}

function reading() {
  if (realReadings) {
    const value = realReadings[realIndex];
    realIndex = (realIndex + 1) % realReadings.length;
    return value;
  }
  const mode = scenario[scenarioIndex].mode;
  return mode === 'warning' ? generateWarning() : mode === 'critical' ? generateCritical() : mode === 'spike' ? generateGradualSpike() : generateNormal();
}

async function send() {
  const mode = realReadings ? `real ${realIndex + 1}/${realReadings.length}` : scenario[scenarioIndex].mode;
  try { const value = reading(); await axios.post(`${backendUrl}/api/sensors/reading`, value); console.log(`[${mode}]`, value); }
  catch (error) { console.error('Send error:', error.response?.data || error.message); }
  if (!realReadings) { count += 1; if (count >= scenario[scenarioIndex].duration) { scenarioIndex = (scenarioIndex + 1) % scenario.length; count = 0; if (scenario[scenarioIndex].mode === 'normal') resetGas(); } }
}

console.log(`${realReadings ? `Real data (${realReadings.length} readings)` : 'Simulator'} -> ${backendUrl} every ${intervalMs}ms`);
setInterval(send, intervalMs); send();

function rand(min, max) { return Number((Math.random() * (max - min) + min).toFixed(1)); }
function generateNormal() { return { mq2: rand(50, 180), temperature: rand(22, 35), humidity: rand(45, 70), flame: 0, rain: 0 }; }
function generateWarning() { return { mq2: rand(200, 390), temperature: rand(38, 46), humidity: rand(20, 35), flame: 0, rain: 0 }; }
function generateCritical() { return { mq2: rand(500, 900), temperature: rand(55, 75), humidity: rand(5, 18), flame: Math.random() > 0.4 ? 1 : 0, rain: Math.random() > 0.6 ? 1 : 0 }; }
let gasLevel = 60;
function generateGradualSpike() { gasLevel = Math.min(gasLevel + rand(8, 25), 850); return { mq2: gasLevel, temperature: rand(28, 42), humidity: rand(30, 55), flame: 0, rain: 0 }; }
function resetGas() { gasLevel = 60; }
module.exports = { generateNormal, generateWarning, generateCritical, generateGradualSpike, resetGas };
